_meta.note: General rescue guidance for the demo. Always route uncertain cases to a pharmacist or prescriber.

default: If you miss a dose, take it when you remember unless it is almost time for the next dose. Never double up. Call your pharmacist if you are unsure.

rules.guidance: Take it as soon as you remember unless the next dose is due soon. Do not double up.
Take it as soon as you remember unless the next dose is due soon. Do not double up. If you feel dizzy, sit down and call your doctor.
Take it as soon as you remember, then continue the schedule. Do not skip doses. Finish the full course.
Contact your prescriber or anticoagulation clinic for instructions. Do not double up.
